name: unlucid-mohini
description: Unlucid Mohini — fully offline, local-only AI chat companion. Talks only to a local Ollama server, no cloud calls.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev:https -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
